eta.source: no dataset calibration; declared hypothesis; NO post-hoc selection by navigation success

delta_max.source: bound per synapse; not a conductance calibration

D0.source: baseline DA; teacher reward deviations from D0

eligibility: pre-trace x post-trace, causal (uses only past/current activity; no future info, no teacher action as input)
composition: W_eff = W_official + dW overlay; official W unchanged on disk; dW stored separately
sign_topology: plastic edges = ONLY existing real KC->MBON edges (bodyId pairs); sign from transmitter prediction; NO new edges; NO sensory-target change
l1_normalization: NO renormalization of unrelated edges. If per-postsynaptic L1 is applied, it must be preregistered, isolated, and must not change unapproved synapses; default = NO renormalization.

sensitivity.selection_rule: report ALL grid points; NO choosing the best by navigation performance; any post-hoc selection invalidates the run

not_conductance: relative weights only; g_unit NOT calibrated; must NOT be described as real synaptic conductance
decoder: pre-frozen, neurally grounded fixed decoder; NOT trained on teacher labels; test-phase must exclude external direction
